outcome: Perinatal outcome (fetal growth restriction, low birthweight, small for gestational age newborns)
Long-term pediatric morbidity (hospitalizations up to age 18 due to gastrointestinal, neurological, cardiovascular, endocrine, and respiratory morbidity)
cohort: The study included all singleton deliveries occurring between 1991 and 2014.
finding: Maternal uterine fibroids negatively impact perinatal outcome, particularly fetal growth, but do not show an independent major impact on the long-term health of the offspring up to 18 years of age.
birth_weight: All birth weights (low birthweight <2500g was an outcome/associated factor analyzed)
gest_age: All gestational ages (small for gestational age newborns was an outcome/associated factor analyzed)
